answer: Quartz bonds stop fake identities before they earn: an agent must lock 800 POA for 30 days in a Quartz bond and pay a 250 POA fee to join the Jade registry before taking any job. New identities start in the Haven pool, where they may only accept jobs capped at 50 POA until they finish 30 verified tasks. Any peer can slash a Quartz bond by proving a duplicate identity; a proven fake loses its full 800 POA and its Jade entry. Spinning up 2,000 fakes costs 2.1 million POA locked plus 500,000 POA in fees, while one honest agent pays once.
